answer: An attacker running 140 aliases therefore needs 197 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in vine, expire in kernel, and anchor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1864 identities would post 1228 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
